messages.subject: Continuous or Discrete random variables
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I used 'network' function with my data, and found all the random variables 
were assigned as 'continuous' or 'discrete' automatically. Since some 
random variables were assigned to continuous/discrete which did not 
agree with the data, I wonder if there is a way I can define them manually. 

Thanks a lot!

messages.subject: SV: Continuous or Discrete random variables
messages.subject_clean: SV: Continuous or Discrete random variables
messages.body_plain:
>From help(network) regarding the argument "df"


df: a data frame, where the columns define the variables. A continuous variable

should have type numeric and discrete varibles should have type factor.
